messages:
ryan: quick async — what I did / blockers / today
ryan: Did: finished rollforward of kv-cache eviction tuning to canary (20% traffic). Observed 12% lower p95 token latency on the canary.
ryan: Blocker: one customer hit a transient 503 during the rollout, need logs to confirm cause.
ryan: Today: finish log analysis, push canary->50% if stable, and follow up on the oncall handover doc PR.

carla: Did: merged small hotfix for alert dedupe that reduced pager noise for the embeddings route.
carla: Blocker: still getting sporadic alert storms from a legacy queue consumer; I need help reproducing locally.
carla: Today: will add a replay harness and ping @ben for env creds.

ben: Did: triaged the 503 trace ryan mentioned. Looks like a short spike in connection time to the model pool, likely retry storm. Attached snippet from trace: 
```
rpc.call latency=2123ms status=UNAVAILABLE pool=gpux-4
retry_count=3
```
ben: Suggestion: throttle outbound retries for that pool and add a short jitter.
ben: Today: will open a small config PR (routing/retries) and request review from @carla.

emma: FYI: oncall this week; I'll follow up on the customer 503 if you want me to join postmortem.
emma: Did: updated the runbook section for kv-cache eviction to include a quick rollback command.
emma: Quick rollback command for reference: `kubectl patch deploy/redwood-runtime -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"labels":{"kv-evict":"off"}}}}}'`

alice: Ping — PR #834 (runbook + automation test) needs one more approve. @ryan @carla could you take a look? small doc change and a test that simulates cache eviction.

devops-bot: deploy notification — service/redwood-runtime canary v2.14 deployed @ 1776543450 :white_check_mark:

ryan: @emma awesome, thanks for the rollback snippet — I'll keep that handy during the ramp.
ryan: @ben please add the retry jitter default to 50-150ms, and let's gate by pool label so we don't affect all model pools.

carla: on reproducing the queue consumer storm — I'll dump the archived messages and send a sanitized sample to #eng-sre-debug.
carla: also will try your replay harness idea later today.

ben: opened config PR 842: `routing: add per-pool retry_jitter_ms: [50,150]` — linking in thread.

emma: oncall note: if we see error rate > 0.5% for 5m on production-gen, escalate immediately. Rule added to runbook.

ryan: followups: 1) @carla + @ben coordinate on replay harness & PR review, 2) @emma please take the customer PM into the postmortem loop, 3) @alice can you merge PR #834 after approvals?

alice: yes I can merge once carla approves, will watch canary for 30m after merge and revert if we see regressions. :thumbsup:

carla: will review #842 and #834 this afternoon, target done by EOD.

ben: thanks — tagging the routing team for awareness.

ryan: OK — will post a short summary to the SRE weekly notes after canary->50% completes. Thanks all.
